title: subscribe
description:
Set the receiver's push filter (spec §8.2).

Replaces the current filter set rather than adding to it, so it is idempotent and re-sending the full desired set after a reconnect is correct. The plugin drops pushes that match nothing, which saves IPC traffic and, more importantly, keeps `seq` free of gaps for topics the core never wanted.

Before the first `subscribe` the filter set is empty and matches nothing. Deny-by-default: a core that forgets to subscribe sees silence, not a flood.
